The '''Riiz Combine''' was small cooperative of weapons manufacturers that produced a line of high-powered [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Blaster cannon/Legends|cannons]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
